exposure: Regional rates of active postnatal care (defined as NICU admission, surfactant, assisted ventilation, antibiotics, and seizures)
Regional rates of antenatal corticosteroids exposure
cohort: The study included 41,707 periviable live-born infants in the US from 2017-2020, with gestational ages of 22 to 25 weeks and birth weights of 400 to 999 g, excluding those with congenital anomalies.
finding: Regional differences in rates of active postnatal care, neonatal intensive care unit admission, provision of assisted ventilation, and antenatal corticosteroid exposure were moderately correlated with survival at 22 weeks' gestation.
